structures.name: Lateral Geniculate Nucleus
structures.about: The thalamic relay for vision. Fibers of the optic tract end here, and its output goes on to the primary visual cortex.

structures.name: Superior Colliculus
structures.about: The rostral pair of rounded swellings on the roof of the midbrain, involved in visual reflexes and orienting the eyes and head.

structures.name: Medial Geniculate Nucleus
structures.about: The thalamic relay for hearing, receiving from the inferior colliculus and projecting on to the auditory cortex.

structures.name: Brachium of the Inferior Colliculus
structures.about: The fiber bundle carrying auditory information from the inferior colliculus forward to the medial geniculate nucleus.

structures.name: Middle Cerebellar Peduncle
structures.about: The largest of the three cerebellar peduncles, carrying fibers from the pons into the cerebellum.
